status: Exploratory external experiment fixed after identity/measurement/scale audit, before any prediction scoring
external_resource: Sound Life processed unstimulated whole-blood RNA and clinical blood counts; Nature 2025 and Science Translational Medicine 2025
primary_target: Clinical bc.perc_neutrophils, percent units; not a single-cell fraction or expression-derived immune score
primary_predictor: Stage53 locked_neutrophil_factor_predictor.npz; all coefficients/scalers unchanged, alpha10
RNA_CBC_join: Exact sample.sampleKitGuid; require identical subject ID, age and sex metadata; many RNA libraries to one clinical record
technical_duplicate_policy: For the two duplicated sample-kit records choose the greatest numeric lib index; never treat aliquots as independent donors
primary_sample_policy: One earliest RNA+CBC-available sampling visit per subject; order by sample.daysSinceFirstVisit, sampleKitGuid, library index; inclusion depends on availability not target value or prediction error
TPM_reconstruction: Published H5AD X is integer gene counts, not TPM. Use the GEO-described GRCh38.91 Ensembl GTF. Gene length is the strand/chromosome-aware union of exons; rates=count/length, TPM=1e6*rate/sum(rate) across all length-annotated genes. Report missing/non-exonic positive-count burden. This is reconstructed gene TPM, not author RSEM TPM or original raw re-quantification.
gene_mapping: Exact published gene symbols matched to saved predictor genes; no outcome-driven alias rescue; absent genes use saved source means (z=0); original module denominator unchanged
no_adaptation_primary: No target-cohort gene centering, ComBat, refitting, target outcome normalization or threshold/seed search
comparators: Stage53 source-trained age/sex model with alpha10 and source constant mean; fit source125 labels only. For the supervised-calibration extension, include the20-calibration-subject target mean as a fair locally informed constant comparator. This comparator was specified before any prediction scoring.
bootstrap: 2000 independent-subject draws on primary one-visit records; 2000 donor-cluster draws for repeated-visit diagnostics
predeclared_calibration_extension: Reserve exactly20 subjects from primary sample table by fixed seeded permutation; calibrate intercept only and affine intercept+slope on their earliest visits. Evaluate once on the remaining subjects. This is supervised target-site calibration, reported separately from unadapted external transport. No calibration subjects' later visits enter held-out longitudinal evaluation.
calibration_features: One locked source prediction only; no new genes, covariates, scores, nonlinear transform or regularization search
longitudinal_diagnostic: On all remaining eligible visits, use the unchanged predictor; report donor-cluster uncertainty and separately compare within-donor demeaned observed/predicted percentages. Repeated visits are not independent external patients.
stop_rule: Do not revise gene scaling, endpoints, calibration complexity, exclusions or seed after viewing results. Report failures and preserve model; no new high-AUC classifier from healthy/infection labels.
novelty_boundary: Independent measurement/transport evidence does not establish a new algorithm or AD diagnosis benefit; future framework augmentation remains a separate experiment.
